name: Garrya Bianti Yogyakarta
short_description: A 24-villa riverside resort on the Denggung River north of Yogyakarta, opened January 2024 as Banyan Tree Group's Garrya wellness brand debut in the city.
ai_summary: Garrya Bianti Yogyakarta opened in January 2024 in Gabugan Village, Sleman -- north of central Yogyakarta -- as Banyan Tree Group's first Garrya-branded property in the city, a wellness-focused brand built around low-density, design-led villas. The resort has 24 villas along the Denggung River, including Pool View, River View, and expansive Two-Bedroom villa categories, each with a private pool, alongside an infinity pool, the 8lements Spa, and the all-day Refresh restaurant serving Indonesian and international menus. Guest reviews consistently praise the villa privacy and design -- blending traditional Javanese touches with contemporary interiors -- along with attentive staff and the restaurant's Indonesian and Thai dishes, though a handful of reviews note the European menu items underperform relative to the Asian ones, and the riverside Sleman location sits a deliberate distance from Yogyakarta's main tourist sites. As a newer property, review volume is still relatively limited.

faqs.question: When did Garrya Bianti Yogyakarta open?
faqs.answer: It opened in January 2024 in Gabugan Village, Sleman, as Banyan Tree Group's first Garrya-branded property in Yogyakarta -- a wellness-focused brand built around low-density, design-led villas along the Denggung River.

faqs.question: How many villas does Garrya Bianti Yogyakarta have?
faqs.answer: 24 villas in total, spanning Pool View, River View, and larger Two-Bedroom categories, each built with a private pool along the riverside grounds in Sleman, north of central Yogyakarta, keeping the resort's overall density low compared to Yogyakarta's larger city-centre hotels.
